desc: Implement Fenwick (BIT) solution with binary-lifting searches for a/b per contest and range-add; answer queries via point queries (O((N+Q) log V)).
Write naive per-query simulation brute force for verification.
Cross-check fast solution vs brute force on small random tests; verify all three sample inputs match expected outputs.

Micro-optimize inner loops (local variable binding, inlined lifting/updates, single read via buffer) and confirm edge cases: empty effect ranges (a > b), L_i above current max, R_i below current min, answers exceeding 5e5 (up to X+N).
